name: io.github.brianhearn/ep-mcp
title: ExpertPack MCP
description: Serve ExpertPack knowledge packs over MCP with hybrid/lexical search, graph traversal, integrity verification, and provenance.

packageArguments.description: Path to an ExpertPack directory (works offline with zero API keys; omit --config for zero-config stdio)

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Gemini API key for vector+BM25 hybrid search (omit for zero-key lexical BM25 mode)

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional OpenAI API key for vector+BM25 hybrid search

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible base URL (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for local Ollama embeddings)

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Azure OpenAI key when using Azure embeddings
